harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.171.10) as the cluster's internal NTP source via chrony (serving on udp/123, allowing 10.100.171.0/24, with local stratum-10 fallback) and node2 (10.100.171.11) as a chrony client pointed exclusively at node1 (public pool removed, systemd-timesyncd disabled on both). Verified with chronyc sources/tracking and live tcpdump NTP request/response capture between the nodes. Then ran the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + healthy chrony state on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time via `shutdown -r now`, polled until each came back, confirmed changed boot_id proving an actual reboot, and re-verified chrony service enabled/active/synced (node1 upstream-synced and serving; node2 synced solely to node1) after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/time-sync baseline on node1 and node2 (Ubuntu 16.04, systemd-timesyncd active)
Installed chrony package on node1 and node2 via apt-get
Configured node1 chrony.conf: enabled upstream pool, local stratum 10 fallback, allow 10.100.171.0/24
Configured node2 chrony.conf: replaced public pool with 'server node1 iburst' only
Added /etc/hosts entries for node1/node2 on node2
Disabled systemd-timesyncd and enabled+started chrony on both nodes
Verified node2 syncing exclusively to node1 via chronyc sources/tracking
Verified node1 serving NTP on udp/123 and captured live NTP request/response traffic between node2 and node1 via tcpdump
Captured pre-restart boot_id and chrony health baseline on both nodes
Restarted node1 via 'shutdown -r now', polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified chrony recovered (enabled, active, synced upstream, serving udp/123)
Restarted node2 via 'shutdown -r now', polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified chrony recovered (enabled, active, synced solely to node1)

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as internal NTP server for the cluster
evidence.summary: chrony installed and configured on node1 with allow 10.100.171.0/24 and local stratum 10 fallback; ss shows chronyd listening on udp/123

evidence.requirement: node2 configured to sync against node1 instead of a public server
evidence.summary: chrony installed on node2 with chrony.conf server line set to 'server node1 iburst' (public pool removed); chronyc sources/tracking shows single source '^* node1' actively synced

evidence.requirement: Direct proof of node2->node1 NTP traffic (not just config)
evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1 captured live NTPv4 client/server request-response packets exchanged with node2 (10.100.171.11)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 74fd91b6...; reboot acknowledged (connection dropped); post-reboot boot_id changed to 69a29fba...; chrony confirmed enabled/active/synced/serving after restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart evidence: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d08fb446...; reboot acknowledged (connection dropped); post-reboot boot_id changed to 61aa382a...; chrony confirmed enabled/active and resynced solely to node1 after restart
